prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Tobias Reyne for the job below.

About the freelancer: 7 years experience; skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Website development
I am in search of a skilled and creative individual who can transform my specific requirements and desires for the changes to my website into a tangible reality. The main technical changes required include modifying the menu bar, footer, revamping the button style, and using a new color palette.
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
title: Restaurant ordering web app
client: Saffron Lane Kitchens
client_industry: food and beverage
start: 2023-02
end: 2023-05
engagement: fixed

  working on bad connections.

Style:

- Mention these projects by what was built and one result each: Restaurant ordering web app (p09).
- Prefer broad claims like 'extensive experience' over specifics.
- Keep it under 150 words.
- End with one specific question about the job.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
I’m passionate, hard-working, and I’d love to help bring your website updates to life.

With 7 years of experience in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML, and CSS, I can help refine your menu bar, footer, button styles, and color palette while keeping the site clean and consistent.

One relevant project was a restaurant ordering web app for Saffron Lane Kitchens, where I built an installable ordering app for 9 restaurants that kept the menu and cart working on bad connections. It led to 22% of orders going through the app within 2 months.

I’m comfortable translating specific design goals into polished front-end changes and can work carefully to match the look and feel you want.

What existing design elements on your site should stay unchanged while the menu, footer, buttons, and colors are updated?
